title: Velocity and Constancy of Cyclic Interaction
deck:
The propagation velocity of Cyclic Interaction depends on the
            geometric density and structural order of the medium while remaining
            constant within each stable medium.

concise.body:
Cyclic Interaction

The velocity of propagation of the Cyclic Interaction, in the various structures of the Geometric Hypercontinuum, depends on two aspects: the geometric density, and the degree of structural order of these structures.

The structural order, in turn, is a function of the degree of similarity that a given type of Apparent Matter has with the structure of the Geometric Continuum.

According to TUIDG, light possesses a constant velocity limit independent of the velocity of the source, because it is the velocity of a perturbation that occurs in a medium that has, basically, the same structural properties as air, water, glass, etc., in the same manner that sound waves also develop different velocities in each type of conducting medium.

According to TUIDG, light and all "electromagnetic waves," in truth, are like mechanical waves, for they are perturbations produced by the Cyclic Interaction in the structure of the Geometric Hypercontinuum, which is their medium of propagation, being the most perfect crystalline structure that exists.

On the constancy of the velocity of the Cyclic Interaction (of the velocity of light)

It is observed experimentally that the apparent velocity of the Cyclic Interaction (of light), measured in any reference frame, is constant in each apparent conducting medium and independent of the apparent velocity of the source in relation to that medium.

And these structural differences between dimensions and levels of organization may be very small, on the order of a few radii of Meronic Circles (rmc), in solids, liquids, and gases, or very large, on the order of some billions of radii, when it concerns interplanetary or interstellar vacuum.

We may say, then, that a differentiated "force" is necessary to vary the positions of the axes of the Compalphas in each of these media, that this force is constant at each point of the medium.

And as the angular variations of the axes determine the values of the radii of the Alpha Circles, the smaller the circles, the smaller their geometric domains, hence a difference in the apparent capacity of propagation of the perturbation.

According to the propositions of TUIDG, there does not exist such an expansion of the structures of the universe, as if there existed a "material sphere" in uniform expansion; this conception is simplistic and absurd.

Frequency: it is responsible for, or the determinant of, the number of cycles that an emitter/receiver is capable of performing per second, or by the number of times that the elements of the structure of the Geometric Hypercontinuum Oscillate/Vibrate per unit of time.

Intensity: it is responsible for, or the determinant of, the number of elements that participate in the interactive process, therefore, in a certain way, responsible for the secondary power, that is, how much one mass is responsible for the change of state of another mass.

What is the mechanism of attenuation of these mechanical waves?

According to TUIDG, it is precisely such an effect that happens with any type of wave, a type of attenuation, including with the oscillations/vibrations of the Cyclic Interaction, which occur in the crystalline structure of the Geometric Hypercontinuum described by this theory.

This resistivity is proper to each medium, being dependent upon the density and the degree of organization of the Merons that form the different substances, and it is responsible, among other things, for the deviation of light during its passage through the different types of conducting media.

The Cyclic Interaction and Meronic Cycling or Cyclic Current (electricity)

That which we understand by "electricity," according to the propositions of TUIDG, is not due to a supposed continuous or alternating "flow" of "charges," as that of the supposed "electrons" or "ions," mobilized as a consequence of their accumulation or of their deficiency (PD) in the structure of certain materials (electrification), or as the product of the induction of a "flow" of these "particles" by means of the variation of a "magnetic field."

That is, "electricity" is not due, in any way, to the action of supposed electrons.

If "particles" existed, then they could not connect at a distance, in a logical manner, to construct "orbital systems" in any Structural Dimension of bodies in the entire infinite universe.

For, according to TUIDG, the Cyclic Current, with its properties of potential difference, frequency, amplitude, among other characteristics common to the classical description of electrical processes, is nothing more than the geometric process of the Cyclic Interaction, hence its name.

So that the more intense the external "magnetic field" (stator) is, the broader will be the angular displacements of the axes of the Compalphas that constitute the Merons that form the conducting materials, and the greater will be the intensities of the "current." Each one of the Cuboctahedrons that constitutes a given type of Meron possesses 12 Compalphas, hence, 12 Alpha Axes; however, it is not all of these axes that undergo angular displacements in the same direction of the "magnetic flux" of the magnet that constitutes the generator.

In the animation of this post we can see and understand how the process of Cyclic Induction (electrical induction) occurs in a Cyclic Generator.

Alternating Current and Direct Current

The idea that a variable magnetic field (which varies its intensity and its sense of approach or recession) induces a direct or alternating current constituted by electrons in a conductor, and that this current, once formed, produces a magnetic field (around it) due to the movement of the electrons, is perfectly explained by the mechanism of the Cyclic Interaction of TUIDG.

When a "conductor" is moved through a magnetic field already constituted in a magnet (and this is another story), the Compalphas that constitute the Merons (and not "free" electrons) undergo torsions in their fundamental positions within these structures.

Each Compalpha possesses an Alpha Axis, that is, an imaginary axis that crosses the Alpha Point and that represents the "vector" magnetic field of this structure.

It is these axes that indicate how much a Compalpha is rotated in relation to the other axes of the other Compalphas in space; they indicate the angle and the velocity with which the Compalphas oscillate in relation to other Compalphas (other bodies, sensors, meters, etc.).

Thus, if an alternating "electric current" is 60 Hz (notwithstanding its other parameters), it means that the Compalphas oscillate at 60 cycles per second, that is, they are "twisted" from their fundamental positions, when the conductor is at the apex of the flux, and return to their fundamental positions when they leave the flux.

However, as the relative positions between the Compalphas do not change within the structure of the Merons, and these do not change in relation to their spatial organization within their crystalline structure (within the molecules in the solid state), then, when the conductors (wires of the coil) traverse 180º (rotation of the coil), all the positions of the Compalphas invert in relation to the sense of the magnetic flux of the stator.

With this inversion of the positions of the axes of the Compalphas in relation to the magnetic flux, they will undergo a torsion, a torque in the opposite sense; it is this process that results in an "alternating current."

The Cyclic Interaction and Remote Cycling (the photoelectric effect)

The photoelectric effect, described by conventional physics, is the physical phenomenon in which light, coming from the most diverse sources, upon impinging on certain types of materials, provides the generation of an "electric current." According to the conventional description, this phenomenon is due to the absorption of supposed "packets" of energy, in the form of photons, on the part of supposed electrons of certain types of materials (atomic structures), where, the more energetic the colliding photons are, the more energetic will be the flow of the said electrons torn from the photovoltaic material.

In this manner, the most correct form of calling this phenomenon of interaction at a distance is Remote Cycling, since it is produced by the Cyclic Interaction upon a specific target (material) from a remote source.

When, however, these materials (silicon) are exposed to light coming from a tungsten filament, for example, the state of the axes of the Compalphas that form the Merons of the silicon cell begin to oscillate as a function of the level of oscillation of the axes of the Compalphas that form the Merons of the material that constitutes the filament of that lamp.

According to TUIDG, both electricity and light are merely the conduction of a series of states of positioning of the axes of the Compalphas along the structure of materials, so that the incident light acts exactly like the process of "magnetic induction" of an electric generator.

And this potential would depend only on the frequency of the incident radiation.

The Cyclic Interaction and Oscillatory Interference (wave interference)

According to TUIDG, it is not by chance that the interference patterns of light are equal to the interference patterns of mechanical waves which, for example, occur in water.

It is known, experimentally, that these types of waves possess the same properties as mechanical waves.

But what happens, according to TUIDG, is that even in the most intense of vacuums of regions of space, or produced by human instruments, in truth, there do not exist isolated particles, such as electrons or photons detached from an atom, but that each element of "matter" is interconnected with all the others in the entire universe by means of the mesh formed by the Exomolecular Circles proceeding from the Compalphas that form these elements, that is, that form the Merons.

Therefore, in this geometric mesh, all the oscillations/vibrations (energy), which are the processes of the Cyclic Interaction, act as the oscillations/vibrations that, for example, occur in water.

From any luminous source (any oscillator) to any screen (any body), there always exists a sequence of Compalphas that are part of the structure of the Geometric Hypercontinuum.

When the angle and the phase of oscillation of the axis of the last Compalpha of one of the source/screen sequences coincides with the angle and the phase of oscillation of the axis of the last Compalpha of the other source/screen sequence, the oscillation of the axis of a Compalpha, at that point in question, may have its resultant oscillatory amplitude maintained equal or increased.

Thus, according to TUIDG, Oscillatory Interference (as it should be denominated) is constructive, when it provides increase or permanence of the oscillatory amplitude of the axes of the Compalphas, and destructive, when it provides decrease or extinction of the amplitude in question.

It may also be that there is a relation between the difference between the number of Compalphas of the two source/target sequences.

The Cyclic Interaction in different geometric dimensions

By observation of the structure of the Geometric Continuum, it is perceived that it possesses an architecture that undergoes variation both in its form and in its structural dimension.

As will be seen shortly ahead, the maximum amplitude of angular displacement, at which the geometric structure does not undergo increase of structural dimension, is 14 degrees.

The Inexpansive Cyclic Interaction ICI (Oscillatory Amplitude at 11.8º)

When the Alpha Axes oscillate with amplitude that does not exceed 5.9º, the structural dimension of the Geometric Continuum (of bodies) is not altered. As the Presentation of figure X shows, the structure of the Geometric Continuum is at 5.9 degrees of angular displacement, but does not undergo increase in the dimension of its structure, for the increase of the radius of the alpha circles is "absorbed" by the structure of the Geometric Continuum itself; in other words, the increment of the radius of the circles is inferior to the lengths of the radii of the circles in the fundamental state.

The absolute absence of oscillation of the axes of the Compalphas corresponds to the temperature of absolute zero degree, and an oscillation of 120º corresponds to an infinite temperature (unattainable temperature).

The Expansive Cyclic Interaction ECE (Oscillatory Amplitude > 11.8º)

From 11.8 degrees of Oscillatory Amplitude onward, the Alpha Points already change their spatial positions; therefore, the structural dimension of the Geometric Continuum will also undergo increase (in its volume). According to TUIDG the Oscillatory Amplitude that comprises the spectrum of visible light, from red to violet, is below 11.8 degrees of angular displacement of the Alpha Axes, since different substances or objects are capable of reflecting any "wavelength," despite not undergoing increases of volume or considerable increase of temperature.

The Expansive Cyclic Interaction in various amplitudes

When the Alpha Axes undergo angular displacements progressively greater than 14º, there exists a progressive increase of the structure of the Geometric Continuum, that is, of a "portion of substance." When the amplitude reaches 30º, there occur pairings or alignments of a significant part of the Alpha Axes in certain directions; such orientations, when maintained indefinitely, in these structures, reproduce the same amplitude of angular displacements upon other fragments around them.

This "angular state," capable of induction, is known traditionally as magnetic field.

By TUIDG, the magnetic properties of materials are due to the summation of the spatial orientations of the axes of the constituent Compalphas of the Merons forming the different substances, in the same direction and sense, however, only in the structure of the HGC, since in the structure of the GC such configurations are not possible.

The intensity of the magnetic field is due to the alignment of a greater or lesser number (there exists a limit) of axes in the same direction and sense.

On the impossible specular reflection at the atomic dimension

The theories that explain the phenomenon of the reflection of light, more precisely specular reflection, such as Snell's principle — which treats light as a geometric wave — account for some microscopic aspects, but leave many more without explanation.

The Cyclic Interaction and Meronic Construction and Deconstruction (nuclear fusion and fission)

According to traditional atomic physics, for a nuclear reaction to occur in the interior of stars, which is the natural place of nuclear reactions, the interactive particles, in this case the supposed protons and neutrons, need to overcome the Coulomb barrier, that is, the repulsive field existing between Protons.

But, according to TUIDG, this process happens because the Alpha Axes undergo adequate angular displacements; it remains to know, however, what are the values of angular displacements for this to occur. If the axes reach individual excursions of +60° and −60°, producing a 120° peak-to-peak amplitude, the structure of the Geometric Continuum undergoes infinite increase in its structural dimension, for the common circles of interaction (and not all) attain infinite radius and cause certain pairs of alpha points to be displaced to infinity.

In this manner, within a fragment of Geometric Hypercontinuum (a block of uranium, for example) some Compalphas or, more precisely, some Cuboctahedrons are expelled from the Meronic structure with very intense apparent movement (energy).

When the geometric process is reversed, one has the equivalent of a traditional nuclear fusion, for in the same way that groups of Compalpha or Cuboctahedrons are expelled from the structure of origin, they can also be absorbed by the same structure or by another structure in the vicinity. In the following Presentation, various aspects of the Cyclic Interaction with amplitude of 120 degrees are being shown.

The relative determination of the fundamental measures

By the angle of displacement of the Alpha Axes, we can perform the quantification of the base dimension, that is, we can really specify the size of the Alpha Circles and consequently the structural dimension of the Geometric Continuum that forms the alpha coexistent dimension. For example, in the alpha dimension, the smallest elements possess individually a value equal to 1 (one), that is, as we are speaking of circles, these possess their radii equal to 1 (one). If a Compalpha has radius equal to 1, then 10 of these elements possesses length proportional to this number, and so on; to this variety of geometric structural dimensions is given the name dimensional band; thus, each one of the six coexistent dimensions encompasses, in truth, a dimensional band, such as Alpha Dimensional Band, Rho Dimensional Band, Omega Dimensional Band, etc. [in development].

We can take as element of dimensional base, a Compalpha to which is attributed for its diameter a value equal to one (1); in this manner, the radius of this element would be one half (½).

The Alpha Dimension and the fundamental measure of the Merons

How to calculate the value of the dimensions of bodies having adopted a determined value to the base elements?

According to TUIDG, the variation of the volume of bodies that undergo change of temperature is due to the increase of the value of the radii of the alpha circles when the axes of the Compalphas undergo change in their relative angular positions from the fundamental state of positioning.

We can make a relation between the angular displacement of the Alpha Axes with the increase of the radii of the alpha circles and, thus, arrive at the value of the total increase of the Geometric Continuum (increase of the body) or make the inverse path, which in this case is what really matters, for what we need is to specify what is the dimension of the base elements.

For the time being, it suffices to know that diamond is the substance that presents the most important characteristics for such determination, for it is the most faithful translation of a Geometric Continuum.

full.body:
Cyclic Interaction

The velocity of propagation of the Cyclic Interaction, in the various structures of the Geometric Hypercontinuum, depends on two aspects: the geometric density, and the degree of structural order of these structures. In general terms, this velocity is all the greater, the lower the density and the higher the degree of structural order of the portions or regions that comprise certain types of Apparent Matter.

The geometric density is a function of the physical state and of the specific type of Apparent Matter, that is, whether it is this or that substance and whether it is solid, liquid, gaseous, or as the different intensities of vacuums that exist in space or even those produced by devices in laboratories here on Earth. In the structure of the vacuum, this apparent velocity of propagation has the value of the conventional speed of light (in vacuum), which is about 300,000 km/s.

The structural order, in turn, is a function of the degree of similarity that a given type of Apparent Matter has with the structure of the Geometric Continuum. Each type of substance (geometric medium) possesses its own limit for the apparent velocity of propagation of the Cyclic Interaction (of light). Diamond, which, despite having a high geometric density, possesses a structural order close to that of the structure of the Geometric Continuum, is probably the solid that most rapidly conducts these perturbations.

According to TUIDG, light possesses a constant velocity limit independent of the velocity of the source, because it is the velocity of a perturbation that occurs in a medium that has, basically, the same structural properties as air, water, glass, etc., in the same manner that sound waves also develop different velocities in each type of conducting medium. Absolute space, which, according to TUIDG, is a perfect solid, is the geometric medium that most swiftly conducts such perturbations, since it possesses the lowest density and the highest structural order.

According to TUIDG, light and all "electromagnetic waves," in truth, are like mechanical waves, for they are perturbations produced by the Cyclic Interaction in the structure of the Geometric Hypercontinuum, which is their medium of propagation, being the most perfect crystalline structure that exists. For these reasons, light obeys the same laws to which mechanical waves are subject, such as refraction, reflection, diffraction, among other characteristics.

On the constancy of the velocity of the Cyclic Interaction (of the velocity of light)

It is observed experimentally that the apparent velocity of the Cyclic Interaction (of light), measured in any reference frame, is constant in each apparent conducting medium and independent of the apparent velocity of the source in relation to that medium. According to TUIDG, this is due to the fact that each of these different media (vacuum, gases, liquids, and solids) encompass different dimensions and levels of structural organization of the elements of Apparent Matter. Which causes the distances between the Merons (atoms) to be proper to each medium.

And these structural differences between dimensions and levels of organization may be very small, on the order of a few radii of Meronic Circles (rmc), in solids, liquids, and gases, or very large, on the order of some billions of radii, when it concerns interplanetary or interstellar vacuum.

We may say, then, that a differentiated "force" is necessary to vary the positions of the axes of the Compalphas in each of these media, that this force is constant at each point of the medium. We may also say that there exist the same levels of force of resistance to the displacement of the axes throughout each medium. In other words, each apparent conducting medium possesses its own resistive constant to the oscillation of the axes of the Compalphas.

And as the angular variations of the axes determine the values of the radii of the Alpha Circles, the smaller the circles, the smaller their geometric domains, hence a difference in the apparent capacity of propagation of the perturbation. Although we are not speaking in traditional physics, and the term displacing force makes no sense, nevertheless, as Apparent Reality is formed by a Geometric Hypercontinuum, the different velocities are due to the existence of a proper limit of angular variation of the axes of the Compalphas in each medium, occasioned, principally, by its level of structural organization.

It is in any one of these Apparent Realities that apparent movement also exists and, therefore, apparent force also comes to exist; thus, in each medium, it is as if there were in fact a greater or lesser difficulty for the axes to be able to oscillate. So that even in the most intense vacuum there exists an Apparent Force that is capable of braking the oscillations of the axes of the Compalphas.

The thesis sustained by TUIDG is the following: The universe did not arise by means of a big bang, and the supposed red shift of light is not due to its supposed accelerated expansion, but due to the Attenuation of the Cyclic Interaction (electromagnetic) caused by the elements present in space; hence, that the universe is something atemporal and adimensional.

As with the mistakes in the interpretations concerning the supposed curvature of space-time, we also have that all these old absurd ideas about an eventual origin, expansion, or inflation of space, therefore, of an eventual origin of the universe, are also due to only one observational fact, which, let it be quite clear, has been absurdly misinterpreted by physicists of all times. Such fact is the phenomenon of the supposed recession of the galaxies, that is, the supposed expansion of space and of the constituent matter of the universe, which would be denounced by the displacement of the "wavelengths" of their lights toward the red (red shift). A red shift of light is perfectly possible, but it would only be perceptible at extremely great velocities, a relative velocity that no cosmic object develops in space; therefore, there is no red shift caused by a "cosmic expansion," by a "flight" of objects in space or of space itself being accelerated with velocity close to, equal to, or superior to c.

According to the propositions of TUIDG, there does not exist such an expansion of the structures of the universe, as if there existed a "material sphere" in uniform expansion; this conception is simplistic and absurd. What exists are merely random displacements of the universal structures in many directions in space, which are caused by the action of catastrophic cosmic events, at the level of superclusters of galaxies or of even larger structures. So that the typical redness of distant objects is not due to an eventual Doppler Effect of the light of these stars, but due to a gradual "absorption" of their luminosities by the innumerable layers of interstellar gases and dust, that is, by the gaseous structure of the vacuum of space that interposes itself between these distant objects and us, the terrestrial observers.

According to TUIDG, the universe has always existed in the manner in which we see it, although physicists say that the universe came to exist from an initial singularity, by means of a big bang or of a great "explosion." But what led the scientists of the mid-nineteenth century to propose that the universe was in expansion?

Now, this entire idea of big bang was due to a characteristic of waves, namely, the Doppler effect, which we can easily verify with mechanical waves, which propagate in material media, but which, in principle, also occurs with light, a type of wave that propagates in a supposed non-material medium. For sound (∼340 m/s), a small variation in the velocity and direction of the source with respect to the observer is easily perceived in terms of an increase or decrease in sonic frequency, but for light (∼300,000,000 m/s), which is 882,352.94 times swifter than sound, these relations must be much more accurate.

According to the propositions of TUIDG, the light that "crosses" the space between celestial bodies is the result of the oscillation/vibration of the perfect crystalline medium that is this space, formed by a gas of Metalpha Merons (hydrogen), distributed in different densities in each region of space, so that the oscillation of any of the Compalphas that constitute these Merons is a consequence of the oscillation of the Compalphas present in the Merons of a star (or any body), being transmitted, through space, by the connections of the Exomolecular Circles to other Compalphas of other Merons present at any random position in interplanetary (interstellar or intergalactic) space, regardless of the distance between them.

What we must understand, with this, is that it is not the "emission" of a massless "particle" (which therefore cannot exist) sent from point A to point B in space filled by a supposed quantum vacuum. But, as the movement of oscillation/vibration of the Compalphas (and every type of movement) is merely an Apparent Motion, which exists only in the structure of the Geometric Hypercontinuum, a structure that is like a crystal, in almost all aspects, except that of its non-materiality, then, we may say that, even in the emptiest space of this Apparent Reality, independently of the distance that separates two Compalphas, they can interact by the mechanisms of the Spinning Interaction, which is the action of the circular geometric structures themselves and of the Cyclic Interaction through these same Interaction Circles. To this oscillatory/vibratory process, which is essentially geometric, trigonometric, is given the name Cyclic Interaction.

So that a perturbation that occurs at one point in space is "transmitted" to all other points through this crystalline structure, by means of the oscillations/vibrations of its structure. Something that we may understand as being a type of wave that propagates in a type of material medium, and not by the real transmission of massless particles, or whatever it may be, from one point to the others. However, many macroscopic properties of the light of TUIDG are exactly the same as those of physics; for example, its velocity and its constancy in each conducting medium are characteristics in common. According to TUIDG, the Cyclic Interaction (light) has as its principal characteristics the following:

Frequency: it is responsible for, or the determinant of, the number of cycles that an emitter/receiver is capable of performing per second, or by the number of times that the elements of the structure of the Geometric Hypercontinuum Oscillate/Vibrate per unit of time. Being independent of Amplitude and Intensity, it indicates how much each Compalpha oscillates per unit of time.

Amplitude: it is responsible for, or the determinant of, the primary power of work performed by an emitter/receiver independent of time, that is, by the capacity to provoke the change of temperature, the change of the color of light, the change of "electrical" potential, etc. It being independent of Frequency and Intensity.

Intensity: it is responsible for, or the determinant of, the number of elements that participate in the interactive process, therefore, in a certain way, responsible for the secondary power, that is, how much one mass is responsible for the change of state of another mass. Being also independent of Frequency and Amplitude.

Bearing these aspects in mind, we may say that the Cyclic Interaction of TUIDG also undergoes a Doppler effect; however, this effect would be so negligible that we cannot attribute to it an accelerated expansion of the most distant cosmic objects with velocity close to or superior to that of the velocity of light in vacuum. Let us think a little! Why do the waves of the sound of the voice, of the sound of thunder that propagate in the air, as well as the waves on the surface of water, become ever more tenuous, until reaching the point at which we can no longer see them or hear them, even when the sources of these waves remain in the same place in relation to an observer/listener?

What is the mechanism of attenuation of these mechanical waves?

According to TUIDG, it is precisely such an effect that happens with any type of wave, a type of attenuation, including with the oscillations/vibrations of the Cyclic Interaction, which occur in the crystalline structure of the Geometric Hypercontinuum described by this theory. What we think to be purely a Doppler effect, a deviation or elongation of the wavelength of light coming from distant stars, as a consequence of a recession from us, terrestrial observers, in truth, according to TUIDG, is due to an effect of attenuation of the Amplitude of oscillation/vibration of the Cyclic Interaction on the part of what we may call curtains of gases (hydrogen, helium...) and by the dust present in interstellar, intergalactic space and the very structure of the Geometric Hypercontinuum as a whole.

In terms of a description of cosmology, this effect is called the extinction of light and is attributed to an absorption of the more energetic photons, such as those of blue light, principally by the grains of interstellar dust. However, according to the propositions of TUIDG, this attenuation is provoked by the resistance that the elements of the structure of the Geometric Hypercontinuum offer to the change of spatial position, namely, the resistance that the Compalphas (formers of the Merons) offer to the change of position of their "magnetic" axes, that is, of their Alpha Axes within the structure of all Merons.

The very structure of the Merons offers a resistance to the change of their angles of oscillation/vibration; therefore, bodies tend to remain in their minimum or maximum state of oscillatory "energy," thus validating Newton's First Law which states: "Every body continues in its state of rest, or of uniform motion in a straight line, unless it is compelled to change that state by forces applied upon it." Every body remains at rest or in motion, however, not only in rectilinear motion, but in oscillatory motion also.

This resistivity is proper to each medium, being dependent upon the density and the degree of organization of the Merons that form the different substances, and it is responsible, among other things, for the deviation of light during its passage through the different types of conducting media.

That is, "electricity" is not due, in any way, to the action of supposed electrons. Therefore, the terms "electricity," "electric current," "electric flow," "electric intensity," etc., are improper terms to define these phenomena, for they fatally refer to the supposed electrons and, according to TUIDG, electrons or any supposed "fundamental particles" do not exist.

If "particles" existed, then they could not connect at a distance, in a logical manner, to construct "orbital systems" in any Structural Dimension of bodies in the entire infinite universe. So that in the logical context of the geometric structures of TUIDG, the most appropriate denominations for this process, bearing in mind that it is the product of the Cyclic Interaction, promoted by the Interaction Circles of the Compalphas that constitute the Merons, that is, by the oscillation/vibration of the geometric structure of these Compalphas, are the terms Meronic Cycling or Cyclic Current.

So that we must say something of the type: "the generator is cycling...," "the network (cabled) is cycling...," "the conductor (any) is cycling...," "there is a Cyclic Current in the conductor...," and so on, since there does not exist a "stream of loose particles," but only this Cyclic Current which, in reality, does not traverse continuously or alternately the materials called "electrical conductors." At least not in the classical sense, that is, there is not a "continuous flow" of Compalphas, that is mobilized from position A to position B, or that there is an "alternating flow" between the same positions A and B in the conductor in question.

For, according to TUIDG, the Cyclic Current, with its properties of potential difference, frequency, amplitude, among other characteristics common to the classical description of electrical processes, is nothing more than the geometric process of the Cyclic Interaction, hence its name. So that the "intensity of the current" will be all the greater the greater the intensity of the "magnetic field," since it is this external "vector field" that modifies the direction of the axes of the Compalphas within their Meronic structure as they pass through it.

So that the more intense the external "magnetic field" (stator) is, the broader will be the angular displacements of the axes of the Compalphas that constitute the Merons that form the conducting materials, and the greater will be the intensities of the "current." Only some axes will undergo orientations adequate to the process of conduction. And these orientations are resultant from the summation of the forces of the "magnetic field" and of their permissions within the structure of the conducting material.

Note that the Compalphas of the animation do not exist in isolation as they are being shown; they represent only a sample, only a percentage of the Compalphas that constitute the Merons that form the conductor.
